Miguel doesn't bother arguing anymore. By dusk the Gather deadfall crews are taking orders from them, and nobody quite remembers when it changed.

🔥 The fire settles. Nazli has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Nevermore — I put it down today." "Its shadow detaches from the branch-shadow and slides across the ground toward you — a straight black lane, growing. The bird hasn't moved. The shadow has." "It climbs, laughing in a dead voice — out of spear reach, watching." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Erich says "And you're still standing." Nikos asks "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
